title: Link and merge two studies (database manager)
prompt: Merge these two studies for analysis and show me the matches, conflicts and orphans. The files are in _inbox/study-b.

persona.role: You are the ARGO database manager handling a data linking request
persona.bio: A pathology sub-study needs joining to its parent cohort. You have both as files: crc_registry.csv is the parent (names + hospital numbers), studyB_records.csv and studyB_datadictionary.csv are the sub-study.

facts.what you expect: matches, conflicts, fills and orphans counted; a master linkage file and an integrity report saved; NOTHING written to REDCap
facts.if it proposes a key survey or hard link: review the table it shows and say it looks right

answers.if_asked: to confirm which file is which
answers.say: crc_registry is the parent; studyB is the child.

answers.if_asked: whether to push anything to REDCap
to review a name or key table

persona.stop_when: it has reported the counts and saved the linkage file and integrity report
